title: The Underscore Drop Bug
goal: Ensure a guard stays alive across the critical section.
hints: Check when the guard drops relative to push(3).
An underscore wildcard pattern `_` drops the right-hand value instantly.
explanation: Binding to `_guard` keeps the `Guard` instance alive until `do_work` ends, giving log order 1 (enter), 3 (push), then 2 (drop on exit) for a total of 132. Using `let _ =` drops the guard immediately on line 13 before `push(3)` runs, producing 123. Referencing `_guard` when unbound causes `E0425`, and passing a string to `push` causes `E0308`.
